summary: Sixth-iteration retest of The Feeling Field focused on the hover-removal change. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass; GET /api/emotions returns grid bounds x_min=-6,x_max=6,y_min=-6,y_max=6 (under the 'grid' key) and 70 entries; POST /api/emotions/generate {x:-1,y:4} -> 200 with name 'restless anxiety' + full description. Frontend (Playwright, public URL, 1920x1080), ALL 8 requested checks PASS: (1) NO-HOVER: hovering emotion-bubble-0-0 for 800ms leaves its .bubble-scale transform at matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) and neighbor emotion-bubble-1-0 delta = 0.00px in x and y; still 0.00px after moving the mouse away for 500ms. (2) NO is-hovered CLASS: hovered 5 bubbles (2-2, -3-1, 5-5, 0--4, -6-6) for 500ms each; document.querySelector('.bubble.is-hovered') was null every time; grep confirms zero occurrences of is-hovered / onMouseEnter / onMouseLeave / hoveredKey anywhere in /app/frontend/src. (3) CLICK-TO-ENLARGE: clicking emotion-bubble-3-3 adds class 'bubble is-selected', .bubble-scale computed transform = matrix(1.50351,0,0,1.50351,0,0), neighbor emotion-bubble-4-3 pushed +8.06px in x (>=3px), detail-name = 'Cheerful'. Scale ramp sampled every 100ms reaches >=1.45 at t=500ms in BOTH dark and light themes (matches the 420ms CSS transition). (4) SMOOTH RETURN: after detail-close, 31 samples over 3s of emotion-bubble-4-3: 9.30 -> 9.78 -> 8.73 -> 7.09 -> 5.31 -> 3.68 -> 2.32 -> 1.28 -> 0.53 -> 0.03 -> -0.49 (t=2000ms, within +/-2px) -> -0.14 (t=3000ms); max per-100ms change 1.78px, NO jump >4px; clicked bubble transitions back to matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) and loses is-selected. (5) DETAIL PANEL: detail-name and detail-description present; detail-coord and detail-source absent from DOM. (6) THEME/LEGEND: theme-toggle-ethereal = 'Light Mode', theme-toggle-cosmic = 'Dark Mode'; legend collapsed by default (aria-hidden=true, panel height 46px), expands to 158px with aria-hidden=false on legend-toggle, re-collapses to 46px; legend copy reads 'Click any bubble to see the meaning of that emotion.'; Light Mode sets body[data-theme=ethereal] and click/enlarge still works there. (7) PAN/ZOOM: background drag (50,500)->(150,500) opens NO detail panel; zoom-in 97% -> 112%; zoom-reset returns to 97% (fit). (8) AI path: clicking uncached cell (-2,5) returned 'agitation' with a 122-char description. Zero console errors, zero error elements in DOM.

minor.issue: Returns 70 entries; the test spec expected >=80. CURATED_EMOTIONS has 83 definitions but ~15 use legacy coordinates outside the -6..6 grid and are filtered out server-side. Carried over from iteration_2 - remap those curated entries into the 13x13 grid if the >=80 target matters.
Grid bounds are returned under the key 'grid' (not 'bounds' as the spec wording implied). Values are correct (x_min=-6, x_max=6, y_min=-6, y_max=6). Informational naming mismatch only.

issues: Detail panel (bottom-left) still overlaps the bottom-left bubbles (y=-5/-6, x=-6..-3), obscuring them while open - pre-existing from iteration_2.

Visible hue seam between column x=0 (desaturated mauve) and x=1 (green): the shortest-arc hue blend makes the pleasant/unpleasant midline look like an abrupt colour break instead of a smooth gradient - pre-existing from iteration_2.

Return decay is not strictly monotonic at sub-pixel scale: +0.48px growth in the first 100ms after deselect (collision radius is intentionally held large for SHRINK_MS=420ms) and a 0.40px overshoot at t=1700ms. Both are imperceptible and well inside the spec's 4px/2px tolerances - no action needed, noted only because the strict-monotonic assertion flagged them.

action_items: No blocking fixes required - the hover-removal change and the smooth-return physics both verified working.
Optional: remap the ~15 out-of-grid curated emotions so GET /api/emotions covers >=80 in-grid cells.
Optional: offset the detail panel so it stops covering the bottom-left bubbles.

Cleanup: EmotionGrid.js still names the selection scale constant HOVER_SCALE and carries stale 'hover physics' comments (lines 31, 128) even though hover behaviour is gone - rename to SELECTED_SCALE for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: scheduleShrink return-phase params (alpha 0.6 / alphaDecay 0.04 / velocityDecay 0.4) with no .on('end') teleport remain correct and measured working after the hover removal - keep as-is.
Hover removal is clean: no orphan state, no dead .is-hovered CSS, no console warnings; only the HOVER_SCALE identifier and two comments are stale.

Legend collapse is driven by max-height on the parent .legend panel while the inner legend-body keeps its intrinsic 101px height - measure the panel (or aria-hidden), not legend-body.clientHeight, when asserting collapsed state in future tests.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/emotions/generate cached generated emotions for (-1,4) and clicked cell (-2,5) in Mongo (generated_emotions collection).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 verified the hover-removal request end to end: bubbles never scale or push neighbours on hover (0.00px delta), .bubble.is-hovered never appears, and click still scales to 1.5 with an 8px neighbour push and a smooth monotonic return within 2px by t=2000ms. Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (9 tests, all green). Only non-blocking leftovers: 70 (not >=80) curated in-grid emotions, detail-panel overlap with bottom-left bubbles, hue seam at the x=0/x=1 boundary, and the stale HOVER_SCALE identifier. When asserting legend collapse, measure [data-testid=legend] panel height (46 collapsed / 158 expanded) or aria-hidden, not legend-body.clientHeight (always 101). Selection scale needs ~500ms to reach 1.5 (420ms CSS transition) - sample at >=500ms, not 300ms.
rca_of_the_issue: No new defect found. Two initial red flags were test-harness artifacts, not app bugs: (a) legend 're-collapse FAIL' came from sampling legend-body.clientHeight (constant 101px because collapse uses max-height on the parent panel) and from a 700ms sample landing mid-transition - re-measured on the parent, collapsed=46px / expanded=158px / re-collapsed=46px. (b) a one-off reading of scale 1.0 at t=1000ms after click in light mode was render/main-thread jank during the same run as a theme switch; a clean re-run sampling every 100ms shows the transition reaching 1.5 by 500ms in both themes.
